description: geoservices.zuid-holland.nl: drinking water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices.zuid-holland.nl. Coverage: the area served by geoservices.zuid-holland.nl. The listing groups 8 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drinking water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Drinkwater zoekgebieden; Drinkwaterbedrijven; Drinkwaterproductieketen; Drinkwaterinfrastructuur. Formats seen: WFS, WMS, OGCFEAT. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
